title: A Done ticket's unmerged work, Accept (a proposal) and the backlog's buttons show they're working

steps.caption: A proposal's Accept: Accepting… until the backlog is written

steps.click: .backlog-item:has-text("Warn on a big diff before review")

steps.waitFor: h1:has-text("Warn on a big diff before review")

steps.caption: Moved to Done with its work unmerged, it warns and offers Merge…, Dismiss and Open Branch

steps.click: body:has(h1:has-text("Warn on a big diff before review")) [role=radio]:has-text("Done")

steps.waitFor: body:has(h1:has-text("Warn on a big diff before review")) .review-panel button:has-text("Merge…")

steps.caption: Dismiss: Dismissing… while it asks which ticket superseded it

steps.click: body:has(h1:has-text("Warn on a big diff before review")) .review-panel button:has-text("Dismiss")

steps.waitFor: body:has(h1:has-text("Warn on a big diff before review")) .review-panel button:has-text("Dismiss"):not([aria-busy="true"])

steps.caption: Merge…: Adding… until the ticket that merges it is added

steps.click: body:has(h1:has-text("Warn on a big diff before review")) .review-panel button:has-text("Merge…")

steps.waitFor: body:has(h1:has-text("Warn on a big diff before review")) .review-panel button:has-text("Merge…"):not([aria-busy="true"])

steps.caption: In the backlog: a card's Mark Done spins, and the card shows it's saving

steps.click: .backlog-item:has-text("List attached files in the activity") [aria-label="Mark Done"]
